OILCLOAK REWARD: at cols 76-97 the floor sinks into a basin of meltwater (surface top row 15, liquid rows 15-16, basin floor row 17), 22 wide; the root ceiling hangs down to row 12 over the whole basin (3 tiles of air) so it cannot be jumped or dashed; beyond it a dry grotto (cols 98-124, floor top 15, sealed at the east end) holds mb_geo2. Vine_lurkers hang from the roots; one thorn_hopper and one pollen_moth patrol the dry stretch.

rooms.name: Weeping Arbor
contents: landmark:weeping wax trees let long pale strands hang to the ground like curtains
rooms.notes: Link between the Garden Gate (N1, cols 8-11) and the Thornwalk (S1, cols 44-47); 64x18. Floor top row 15. Under N1: one-way platforms tops rows 12, 8, 4 (last directly under N1) for the climb back to mb_01. Around S1 the floor dips to top row 16 for 3 cols on each side (landing ledge for players rising from the Thornwalk). GRIP REWARD: at the east end a sheer trunk (cols 56-58, plain #, no knots or footholds) rises from the floor to top row 6 (9 tiles; out of Smokewing reach); a hollow in its crown (cols 56-61, rows 3-5) holds Heartwax Shard mb_hw1. Vine_lurkers hang in the strands; one pollen_moth.

rooms.name: The Chimney Tops
contents: landmark:Ash Ridge - a field of ruined brick chimney stacks smoking against the dusk, east of the village; one giant crown breathes red light
rooms.notes: Surface room (128x18) above the Sootflue, east of Lastlight. W1 (rows 11-13, floor top row 14) from Wickwright's Row. ONE-WAY SHORTCUT: sf_gate1 (iron portcullis, w1 h4, opens lever:sf_lv1) stands at col 6, rows 10-13, with a solid lintel above it; from the village side the player sees the bars and, beyond them, the lever. sf_lv1 is at col 10 on the east side of the gate - it can only be struck from the Flue side. Once open, Lastlight <-> Great Flue is a quick route (drop down the flue, climb up with grip). East zone: ash-crusted roofs, floor top row 14 with 1-3 tile chimney stubs to hop. S1 (cols 110-113) is the mouth of the Great Flue, set in a huge chimney crown (decor ring around it, red glow and smoke rising); the floor around the mouth dips to top row 15 for 3 cols each side (landing ledge for a player climbing out of the flue). lore_sf_1 (a chimney-sweep's plaque) at col 92. WINGS REWARD: the tallest stack (cols 60-63, faces of GLAZED (X) tiles, no wall within 6 tiles) has a flat top at row 7 (7 tiles above the roof) with sf_geo1 on it. Ash_bats circle the stacks, soot_sprites bob over the roofs.

rooms.name: The Great Flue
contents: landmark:THE GREAT FLUE - a colossal brick chimney, 80 tiles tall, crossed by a single iron gantry; red embers stream upward past the player
rooms.notes: Landmark vertical shaft (32x81), the spine of the region. GANTRY: an iron catwalk, floor top row 33, spans the shaft from W1 (rows 30-32, from the Broken Bridge) to E2 (rows 30-32, Bellows Hall); a 4-wide gap in its middle (cols 14-17, fenced by lips) lets the player drop down. ABOVE THE GANTRY (grip gate): sheer brick walls (# grippable) with NO footholds, platforms or pogo targets from row 32 up to the crown; the only ledge is the loft landing (cols 23-30, floor top row 15) at E1 (rows 12-14) and the crown at N1 (cols 14-17, row 0). Without Wax Grip the upper flue is unreachable; with it the player wall-jumps up, either into the Soot Lofts (E1) or out through N1 to the Chimney Tops. Dropping back down is always free. BELOW THE GANTRY: iron rungs - one-way platforms (=) 4-6 wide alternating sides with tops never more than 4 rows apart (rows 37, 41, 45, 49 ... down to the floor top row 78) so the bottom is reachable and climbable without abilities. E3 (rows 48-50) opens onto an east ledge (cols 22-30, floor top row 51) on that stair. E4 (rows 75-77) at the floor (top row 78) leads straight into the Soot Matron's den. sf_sconce_b on the shaft floor at col 8 (the rest before the Matron; a light). lore_sf_2 (a stoker's oath) on the gantry rail at col 6. Chimney_crawlers on the walls below the gantry, ash_bats in the air.

rooms.name: The Soot Lofts
contents: landmark:dusty rafters hung with soot-sacks above the bellows; a pane of kiln glass glints on a cooling rack
rooms.notes: Hidden-ish upper room (96x18), reachable only by wall-climbing the Great Flue (W1 rows 12-14) or the Ember Shaft (E1 rows 12-14). Floor top row 15 of old rafters (gaps of 2-3 tiles to hop, no hazards beneath beyond the floor below at row 17). Kiln Glass sf_kg on a cooling rack at col 50 (glow). Soot_sprites among the sacks, one stoker shovelling at col 70.

rooms.notes: Long hall (96x18) east of the gantry; floor top row 15 (W1 and E1 rows 12-14). The giant bellows (animated decor) fill the background at cols 40-56. sf_sconce_a at col 18 (first rest in the Flue; light). lore_sf_3 (a bellows-keeper's tally) at col 30. Ceiling: rows 0-2 solid in general, but between cols 37 and 60 the brickwork hangs low (solid rows 0-8, hall air rows 9-14). SECRET: a brick shelf (cols 28-34, top row 9) reached from the floor via a crate (top row 12, cols 31-33); from the shelf, the low ceiling's west face (cols 37-38, rows 6-8) is B; behind it a cramped smithy (cols 39-46, rows 6-8, floor top row 9) holds the Quickwick sigil on an anvil. Two stokers patrol the floor; one soot_sprite.

spots.secret: breakable wall (B) on the top landing
breakable wall (B) on the top landing
breakable wall (B) on the top landing

contents: landmark:a narrow shaft where embers rise in a steady glowing stream
rooms.notes: Narrow shaft (32x54) east of the hall. W2 (rows 21-23) from Bellows Hall opens onto a landing (cols 1-10, floor top row 24). From there down to W3 (rows 39-41, floor top row 42) one-way platforms (=) zig-zag with tops at rows 27, 30, 34, 38 (free both ways). ABOVE W2 (grip gate): sheer # brick for 18 tiles, no footholds; at the top a landing (cols 1-30, floor top row 6) at W1 (rows 3-5, to the Soot Lofts). On that top landing a B partition (cols 22-23, rows 3-5) hides a cubby (cols 24-30, rows 3-5) holding Chandler's Spark spark_sf. PLUNGE REWARD: the shaft floor at row 42 has a cracked section - D floor at cols 8-15, rows 42-43; below it a sealed vault (cols 4-26, air rows 44-50, floor top row 51) holds Heartwax Shard sf_hw1; one-way platforms (tops rows 48 and 45, cols 16-19) next to the broken hole let the player climb back out (51 -> 48 -> 45 -> 42). Ash_bats in the updraft, a chimney_crawler on the walls.

rooms.name: The Pipeworks
contents: landmark:a tangle of iron pipes and valves venting steam; below the walkway a cooling cistern of meltwater lies under a huge pipe
rooms.notes: Two-level room (96x27). Upper walkway floor top row 15 links W1 (rows 12-14, from the Great Flue's east ledge) and E1 (rows 12-14, to the Ember Shaft); pipes along the ceiling, steam vents (decor). A stair of 3-tile steps at cols 6-12 leads down to the lower cistern level (floor top row 24, cols 4-30). OILCLOAK REWARD: east of the stair the lower level is a cooling cistern - meltwater 16 wide (cols 31-46, surface top row 22, liquid rows 22-23, basin floor row 24) under a giant horizontal pipe whose underside is at row 19 (3 tiles of air above the water), so it can be neither jumped nor dashed; past it a dry valve room (cols 47-58, floor top row 24, walled off above by the walkway) holds sf_geo2. The upper walkway must stay continuous over the cistern (rows 15-18 solid there). Chimney_crawlers on the pipes, one stoker on the walkway, an ash_bat.

rooms.name: The Matron's Den
contents: landmark:a soot-black nest at the bottom of the chimneys, its walls crusted with egg-sacs that glow like coals
rooms.notes: BOSS ARENA - THE SOOT MATRON (48x27, with platforms). Floor top row 24 (rows 24-26 solid) across cols 1-46. W1 (rows 12-14) enters onto a west ledge (cols 1-5, floor top row 15) high above the den; a stair leads down: a solid step (cols 6-9, top row 18) and a one-way platform (cols 10-14, top row 21) - this stair is also the way back out (24 -> 21 -> 18 -> 15). Other platforms for her wall/platform leaps: center one-way platform (cols 20-28, top row 17) and east one-way platform (cols 33-38, top row 21). Both side walls are plain # (she clings to them). E1 (rows 21-23) at floor level on the east wall. Gates: arena_gate (w1,h4) at col 1 rows 11-14 (on the west ledge, under a solid lintel at row 10; shuts behind the player) and gate sf_gate9 (w1,h4, opens boss:matron) at col 46 rows 20-23 (lintel at row 19; the way east to the grip shrine, shut until she falls). arena entity: boss matron, bx=30, by=6 (she hangs from the ceiling, then drops), trigger cols 10-38 rows 16-23 (fires when the player reaches the den floor). No tile hazards (ash-fall and soot balls are her attacks). After victory both gates open; the Grip shrine is through E1.

rooms.name: Shrine of the Wax Grip
contents: landmark:a soot-streaked chapel; a sheer wall of brick beyond the pedestal, and over it, the red glow of the Ashpit
rooms.notes: Room after the Matron (48x27), no enemies. Floor top row 24 (W1 rows 21-23). Wax Grip shrine pedestal at col 12 (requires boss:matron). lore_sf_4 at col 6. GRIP LESSON / GATE: east of the shrine a sheer brick wall (cols 22-25, plain #, no footholds) rises 8 tiles from the floor to top row 16. Beyond it the chute (cols 26-46): its floor is also at top row 24 with the S1 opening (cols 36-39) in it, dropping into the Ashpit. The wall is 8 tiles high on both faces, so crossing it in either direction needs Wax Grip (wings alone cannot clear 8). A player rising out of the Ashpit through S1 lands on the chute floor beside the hole (chute floor dips to top row 25 for 3 cols each side).

rooms.name: The Ashpit

rooms.notes: Bottom of the Flue (64x18), the way down to the Chandlery. Floor top row 15 of deep ash. N1 (cols 20-23) up into the Grip shrine's chute: one-way platforms tops rows 12, 8, 4 under it. E1 (rows 12-14) leads into the Chandlery's Slag Gate through a heavy iron door frame (decor). SECRET: at the west end a B wall of compacted ash (cols 6-7, rows 12-14) hides a niche (cols 1-5, rows 12-14) with sf_geo3. Chimney_crawlers, one ash_bat.

rooms.name: The Long Descent
contents: landmark:a deep wet shaft where the rain begins; water sheets down the walls and the sound of a far bell rises from below
rooms.notes: Entry shaft from the Guttered Ways (32x36). N1 (cols 12-15) is where the player drops in from the Descent Lip. The fall is long: floor top row 33 at the bottom (W1 and E1 rows 30-32, to the Flooded Aisle and the Gallery of Saints). The shaft walls are plain # (grippable) with NO ledges, platforms or pogo targets anywhere above the floor: climbing back to the Guttered Ways needs Wax Grip (wall-jump up the walls, rise out through N1 into the pit of gw_10). Water streams down the walls (decor only, no liquid tiles). lore_dn_1 (a pilgrim's scratched prayer) at the bottom, col 8. Two rain_jellies drift in the lower half (never placed where they block the wall climb).

rooms.name: The Flooded Aisle
contents: landmark:a long side aisle of the cathedral under broken clerestory windows; rain falls in silver curtains
rooms.notes: Corridor (128x18). Floor top row 15 (E1 rows 12-14 from the Long Descent, W1 rows 12-14 into the Bell Tower). Puddles are decor only (no ~ tiles on the walkway). S1 (cols 40-43) is a broken floor opening down into the great nave; around it the floor dips to top row 16 for 3 cols each side (landing ledge for players climbing up from dn_03). Wren (stage 2) shelters under a dry arch at col 84 (her flame is lower now). lore_dn_2 (a list of the drowned) on a column at col 60. dn_geo1 in a collapsed pew alcove at col 104. Three drowned_acolytes along the aisle, two rain_jellies under the windows.

rooms.name: The Drowned Nave
contents: landmark:THE DROWNED NAVE - a vast cathedral hall, its rose window of pale-gold glass still glowing; rain pours through the shattered vault onto rows of drowned pews
rooms.notes: REGION HUB and landmark (96x36). Main floor top row 33 (rows 33-35 solid) with drowned pews (decor; no ~ tiles on the floor). W1 (rows 30-32) at the floor to the Flooded Tunnel. A raised choir step at the east (cols 70-95, floor top row 24) reached by 3-tile steps; E1 (rows 21-23) there leads to the Choir Loft. N1 (cols 40-43) is the opening from the aisle above: a column of one-way platforms (=) with tops at rows 29, 25, 21, 17, 13, 9, 5 (alternating slightly left/right of cols 38-45) climbs to it. S1 (cols 60-63) is a hole in the floor down to the Sunken Crypt; around it the floor dips to top row 34 for 3 cols each side. dn_sconce_a at col 28 under the rose window; Lanternway post nave at col 52; lore_dn_3 on the lectern at col 46. The rose window (decor) dominates the back wall; light shafts and rain. One drowned_knight on the floor, two acolytes, a bell_sentry on the choir step.

contents: landmark:the hollow bell tower, its great bell long fallen; rain hisses down its throat
rooms.notes: WALL-CLIMBING CHALLENGE to the Oilcloak (32x54). E1 (rows 30-32) enters onto the base floor (floor top row 33). A hole in the base floor (cols 14-17) drops 20 tiles down the lower shaft to S1 (cols 14-17, bottom row) into the Flooded Tunnel; one-way platforms in the lower shaft (tops rows 50, 46, 42, 38) let the player climb back up to the base. THE CLIMB (grip only): the shaft interior (cols 6-25) rises 18 tiles from the base floor (33) to the top. Two ledges jut from the walls at top row 15: the west landing (cols 1-12) at W1 (rows 12-14) and the east ledge (cols 19-30), leaving a 6-wide throat (cols 13-18) through which the climber emerges. The climb is pure wall-jumping between the two # wall faces (cols 5 and 26) with short ^ spike strips on alternating wall sections and a few GLAZED (X) stretches that force wall switches with timing; no ledges, platforms or pogo targets anywhere between rows 16 and 32 (Smokewing alone must not suffice). SECRET: on the east ledge, behind the hanging bell frame (decor), a B wall (cols 24-25, rows 12-14) hides a niche (cols 26-30, rows 12-14) with dn_geo3. A bell_sentry on the west landing, rain_jellies in the shaft (placed so they can be pogo-ed but never required).

rooms.name: Shrine of the Oilcloak
contents: landmark:a tiny chapel at the top of the tower; a basin of still meltwater reflects a floating blue ember
rooms.notes: Dead-end chapel (32x18) off the top of the Bell Tower (E1 rows 12-14). Floor top row 15. Oilcloak shrine pedestal at col 18. West of the shrine (cols 3-9) a small practice basin of meltwater (surface top row 15, liquid rows 15-16, 7 wide) to try floating right away - it must lie WEST of the shrine so it never blocks the way to it. lore_dn_4 (a vow of the bell-ringers) at col 26. No enemies.

rooms.name: The Choir Loft
contents: landmark:tiers of drowned choir stalls beneath silent organ pipes; a great bronze door to the east hums with the tone of a bell
rooms.notes: Room (64x27) before the Abbot. Floor top row 24 (W1 and E1 rows 21-23); tiered stalls step up along the back (decor and 1-3 tile platforms). S1 (cols 20-23) is a hole down to the Baptistery; around it the floor dips to top row 25 for 3 cols each side. dn_sconce_b at col 42 next to the belfry door (E1 -> Tallowmere). lore_dn_5 (a hymn sheet) at col 30. A bell_sentry and two acolytes guard the stalls.

rooms.name: The Great Belfry
contents: landmark:a flooded belfry under a broken roof; a colossal bronze bell hangs over a drowned floor
rooms.notes: BOSS ARENA - ABBOT TALLOWMERE, Warden of the Bell (64x27). Single entrance W1 (rows 21-23). Floor top row 24 (rows 24-26 solid) flat across cols 1-62 - keep it clean for the bell shockwave rings. Two one-way choir lofts (=, top row 20 - 4 tiles above the floor, reachable without Smokewing) at cols 12-19 and 44-51 to hop rings and dodge the belly slam. Ceiling solid rows 0-2; the giant bell (decor) hangs at cols 28-35, rows 6-11, on chains from the vault at row 3 (not solid; its lip shows at the top of the fight view). No tile hazards (molten drips are his attack). arena_gate (w1,h4) at col 2 rows 20-23 under a solid lintel at row 19. arena entity: boss tallowmere, bx=38, by=23, trigger cols 17-30 rows 14-23. Phase 2 acolytes enter from the east side (cols 55-60). Reward: Seal of the Bell (+300 cinders), then the gate reopens.

rooms.name: The Sunken Crypt

breakable wall (B) of a burial niche at the west end

contents: landmark:a crypt beneath the nave; the floor is cracked and frost creeps up through the cracks from far below
rooms.notes: Crypt (96x18) under the great nave. Floor top row 15. N1 (cols 60-63): one-way platforms tops rows 12, 8, 4 under it (climb back into the nave). E1 (rows 3-5) is a high doorway on the east wall, floor top row 6 on a ledge (cols 84-95) reached by 3-tile steps (tops rows 12, 9, 6) from the crypt floor. PLUNGE GATE (one-way into the Rime): a frosted cracked floor - D tiles at cols 10-17, rows 15-16 - sits over the S1 opening (cols 12-15, row 17 open) so a Molten Plunge breaks through and the player falls into the Rime (no way back up through this hole; the return from the Rime is the Reliquary stair). Frost decor around the cracks so the promise is visible early. SECRET: a B wall (cols 6-7, rows 12-14) at the west end hides a burial niche (cols 1-5, rows 12-14) with the White-hot Core sigil. One drowned_knight, two acolytes.

rooms.name: Gallery of Saints
contents: landmark:a gallery of colossal saint statues with worn faces; at its end a sheer wall and a broken span toward a red forge-glow
rooms.notes: GRIP + DASH GATE toward the Chandlery (96x18). W1 (rows 12-14) from the Long Descent; floor top row 15 across cols 1-57 (the west floor). At cols 41-48 a sheer # pillar rises 8 tiles from the floor to a near ledge (top row 7, cols 41-48) - wall-jump up (grip). From its east lip a 9-tile gap at equal height (cols 49-57; critical-path dash gaps are 9 tiles, 10 only for optional rewards) to the far ledge (top row 7, cols 58-70). The far ledge is the top of a solid mass (cols 58-95) whose WEST FACE IS GLAZED (X) from row 7 down to the floor, so a player who falls into the gap lands on the west floor and cannot climb the far side. From the far ledge the path steps down east (tops 10, 13, 15) to E1 (rows 12-14). Going back west is free: drop off the far ledge's lip into the gap. WINGS REWARD: the tallest saint statue (cols 18-23) has a flat head at top row 8 (7 above the floor), GLAZED (X) faces, no wall within 6 tiles; Heartwax Shard dn_hw1 rests in its open hands. One drowned_knight on the west floor, rain_jellies under the vault.

rooms.name: The Flooded Tunnel
contents: landmark:the drain of the Nave - a long tunnel where the floodwater runs west into darkness under a low vault
rooms.notes: OILCLOAK GATE to the Mothwood (96x18). East part (cols 60-95) dry, floor top row 15 (E1 rows 12-14 from the great nave). N1 (cols 78-81) is the bottom of the Bell Tower shaft: one-way platforms tops rows 12, 8, 4 under it. dn_geo2 at col 66. From col 59 westward the tunnel floods: meltwater from col 8 to col 58 (51 wide; surface top row 15, liquid rows 15-16, basin floor row 17) under a low vault whose ceiling is at row 11 (solid rows 0-11; 3 tiles of air above the water) all the way to the west bank (cols 1-7, floor top row 15) and W1 (rows 12-14). Without Oilcloak the water is a hazard; with it the player swims through. Rain_jellies hover in the dry part.

rooms.name: The Baptistery
contents: landmark:a round baptistery; the font is frozen over and a cold draught rises from the east
rooms.notes: Room (64x18) below the Choir Loft. Floor top row 15. N1 (cols 20-23): one-way platforms tops rows 12, 8, 4 under it (climb back to the loft). W1 (rows 12-14) to the high east doorway of the Sunken Crypt; E1 (rows 12-14) to the Reliquary. The round font (decor) at col 34, rimmed with frost. lore_dn_6 (the Abbot's sermon on mercy) at col 44. Two acolytes, one rain_jelly.

rooms.name: The Reliquary
contents: landmark:shelves of reliquaries in a cold vault; an ice-choked stairwell descends into blue light
rooms.notes: Room (64x27) at the edge of the Rime. Hall floor top row 15 across cols 1-49 (W1 rows 12-14); tall reliquary shelves along the back (decor, a few one-way platforms for fun, none higher than row 9 and none east of col 36). THE ICE STAIR (up-only shortcut from the Rime): S1 (cols 52-55) is the bottom of a shaft enclosed inside a solid ice pillar (cols 50-57, rows 6-26; inner shaft walls plain # so grip can climb them, no ledges). The shaft emerges at the top onto a high ledge (top row 5, rows 5-6 thick) that spans cols 40-57 and overhangs the hall; from its west lip (col 40) the player simply drops 10 tiles to the hall floor. From the hall the ledge can never be reached: it is 10 tiles up (beyond Smokewing), the pillar faces, the ledge's lip and underside are GLAZED (X), and nothing climbable stands within 6 tiles - so the Nave cannot be used to enter the Rime without plunging, while a player coming up from the Rime always gets home. PLUNGE REWARD: in the west half a cracked reliquary floor - D at cols 8-13, rows 15-16 - covers a sealed vault (cols 4-24, air rows 17-21, floor top row 22) where Chandler's Spark spark_dn lies in an open reliquary; climb out by a one-way platform (top row 19, cols 14-16) beside the broken hole (22 -> 19 -> 15). One drowned_knight guards the shelves.

rooms.name: The Slag Gate

spots.secret: breakable wall (B) of slag bricks at the east end
breakable wall (B) of slag bricks at the east end

contents: landmark:a gate of riveted iron plates crusted with old slag; beyond it the roar of the forges
rooms.notes: Upper entrance from the Sootflue (64x18). Floor top row 15 (W1 rows 12-14 from the Ashpit). S1 (cols 8-11) is a hole down to the Pouring Floor; one-way platforms in ch_03 below it for the climb back; around S1 the floor dips to top row 16 for 3 cols each side. lore_ch_1 (a foundry work-order) on the gate at col 20. SECRET: the east wall area is a slag-brick store: a B wall (cols 50-51, rows 12-14) hides a storeroom (cols 52-62, rows 11-14, floor top 15) with Kiln Glass ch_kg on a rack. Two moldlings, one forge_wisp.

rooms.name: The Pouring Floor
contents: landmark:rows of giant ladles tip molten wax into candle molds along a channel of glowing lava
rooms.notes: Room (64x27). N1 (cols 40-43) from the Slag Gate: one-way platforms (tops rows 21, 17, 13, 9, 5) under it. Floor top row 24 (W1 and E1 rows 21-23). A molten channel (% lava, 2 deep, flat surface at row 24) runs along the floor at cols 22-30 (9 wide): it is crossed by two iron grates (one-way platforms top row 21, cols 21-24 and 28-31) - a normal jump suffices, never dash. Big ladles (decor) tip glowing streams in the background. ch_geo2 on a mold rack at col 52, top row 18 (a 3-tile step from a crate). Three moldlings, one ladle_brute guarding the east door (E1 -> the Crucible Climb).

rooms.name: The Crucible Climb
contents: landmark:a towering crucible chimney; at its brim, high above lakes of molten wax, a blue ember hovers over a dented anvil
rooms.notes: PLUNGE SHRINE behind a GRIP + DASH challenge (64x36). W1 (rows 21-23) enters on the foot ledge (cols 1-10, floor top row 24, solid below). The rest of the room bottom is a lake of molten wax (% lava, surface row 32, liquid rows 32-34, cols 11-62) - falling in = hazard respawn on the last safe ledge. Solid stepping blocks (top row 24) at cols 15-18 and 24-27 (gaps <= 5) lead east to THE CRUCIBLE WALL (cols 30-33): its upper part rises from row 20 to a top at row 10 (10 tiles, plain # face on the west, no footholds; built without ^ strips) - wall-climb it (grip). Under it a tunnel (rows 21-23, floor top 24) passes through to the east ledge (cols 34-52, top row 24) - a dead end without abilities. From the wall top a 9-tile gap at equal height (cols 34-42) leads to the brim (a solid shelf, cols 43-62, rows 10-12, GLAZED (X) faces and underside) - dash (or Smokewing). The Molten Plunge shrine stands on the brim at col 56. Way back: dash back over the gap, or (teaching the new spell) plunge through the D patch in the brim (cols 46-49, rows 10-12) and land on the east ledge, then walk west through the tunnel. Two forge_wisps drift over the lava (pogo-able, never required).

rooms.name: The Great Foundry
contents: landmark:THE GREAT FOUNDRY - a cavern of chains and gantries above a river of molten wax; a colossal empty mold in the shape of a knight hangs from the ceiling
rooms.notes: REGION HUB and landmark (96x36). Three levels: (1) upper gantry, floor top row 6, from W1 (rows 3-5, from the Gallery Gate) east to col 40; (2) middle walkway, floor top row 24, joining E1 (rows 21-23, Pouring Floor) across most of the width; (3) lower floor, top row 33, joining W2 (rows 30-32, Mold Racks), S1 (cols 20-23, down to the Quench Gate ch_06) and S2 (cols 80-83, down to the Kiln Antechamber ch_08). The levels are linked by chain-hung one-way platforms and iron stairs, never more than 4 rows apart, so the whole hub is free to move through without abilities. Molten wax appears only in the background art (falls and a glowing river in the parallax); no lava tiles on any route here. Around S1 and S2 the lower floor dips to top row 34 for 3 cols each side. ch_sconce_a at col 30 on the middle walkway; Lanternway post chandlery at col 62 on the middle walkway; lore_ch_2 (the Kiln Mother's decree) on a mold plaque at col 12 on the lower floor. A colossal hanging knight-mold (decor) in the center. A ladle_brute on the middle walkway, moldlings and drip_slimes on the lower floor.

rooms.name: The Gallery Gate
contents: landmark:where the cathedral's stone gives way to the riveted iron of the forges
rooms.notes: Western entrance (64x18) from the Gallery of Saints (W1 rows 12-14). Floor top row 15. E1 (rows 12-14) onto the Foundry's upper gantry. S1 (cols 20-23) a hole down to the Mold Racks; one-way platforms in ch_07 under it for the climb back; around S1 the floor dips to top row 16 for 3 cols each side. ch_geo1 in a slag heap at col 44. Two moldlings, one drip_slime on the ceiling.

rooms.name: The Mold Racks
contents: landmark:racks of half-formed wax soldiers in their molds, row upon row, none of them lit
rooms.notes: Room (64x27). N1 (cols 20-23) from the Gallery Gate: one-way platforms tops rows 21, 17, 13, 9, 5 under it (the floor is at row 24). Floor top row 24; E1 (rows 21-23) to the Foundry's lower floor. S1 (cols 40-43) is a hole down to the Cooling Cellar; around it the floor dips to top row 25 for 3 cols each side (cols 37-39 and 44-46). Racks of soldier molds (decor) in tiers, with one-way platforms (tops 20 and 16) for fun. lore_ch_3 (a mold-maker's tally of soldiers poured) at col 10. PLUNGE REWARD: at the east end a raised casting block (solid, cols 50-62, top row 18, reached by a 3-tile step at cols 47-49, top row 21). A cracked floor - D at cols 54-58, rows 18-19 - covers a sealed casting pit inside the block (cols 51-61, air rows 20-23, floor top row 24) holding Chandler's Spark spark_ch. Climb out: a one-way platform (top row 21, cols 59-61) beside the broken hole (24 -> 21 -> 18). Three moldlings stagger off the racks, one drip_slime.

contents: landmark:a cellar of cooling racks where fresh candles harden in rows; steam rises from quenching troughs
rooms.notes: Room (64x18). N1 (cols 40-43) from the Mold Racks: one-way platforms tops rows 12, 8, 4 under it. Floor top row 15; E1 (rows 12-14) to the Quench Gate. SECRET + DASH: the west part of the room is walled off by stacked cold molds - a B wall (cols 22-23, rows 4-14, floor to ceiling). Behind it the floor ends at col 21 at a quench trough of molten wax 10 wide (cols 11-20; % lava with its surface flush with the floor, top row 15, liquid rows 15-16, row 17 solid) - too wide to jump (lava cannot be pogo-ed), crossed with Flare Dash (or Smokewing). The far ledge (cols 1-10, floor top row 15; its face toward the trough is GLAZED X) holds the Ember Urn ch_urn. Drip_slimes on the ceiling, one moldling.

rooms.name: The Quench Gate
contents: landmark:a quenching hall where molten wax meets ice water; the floor is cracked and frost breathes up through it
rooms.notes: Room (64x27). N1 (cols 20-23) from the Foundry: one-way platforms tops rows 21, 17, 13, 9, 5 under it (cols 19-24). Floor top row 24. W1 (rows 12-14) is a raised doorway: a ledge (cols 1-8, floor top row 15) reached by 3-tile steps (cols 9-11, tops 21 and 18). E1 (rows 21-23) at floor level to the Kiln Antechamber. PLUNGE GATE (one-way into the Rime): a frosted cracked floor - D tiles at cols 12-19, rows 24-25 - over the S1 opening (cols 14-17, row 26 open) drops the player into the Glacier Gallery; no way back up through it. DASH REWARD: a stepped pillar (solid, cols 34-39, tops 21, 18, 15 on its west side, flat top row 12) faces, across a 10-tile gap at equal height (cols 40-49), a high ledge (cols 50-58, top row 12, GLAZED X faces, no wall within reach) where the Flare Trail sigil rests. Two forge_wisps, one moldling.

rooms.name: The Kiln Antechamber
contents: landmark:a scorched antechamber before a huge round furnace door that glows from within like a heart
rooms.notes: Room (64x27) before the Kiln Mother. N1 (cols 16-19) from the Foundry: one-way platforms tops rows 21, 17, 13, 9, 5 under it. Floor top row 24 (W1 rows 21-23 from ch_06). E1 (rows 12-14) is the furnace door to the Kiln Heart, on a raised ledge (cols 50-63, floor top row 15) reached by 3-tile steps (tops 21, 18, 15). ch_sconce_b at col 27 (rest before the Warden; warm light). lore_ch_4 (scratched by a soldier: "she cannot stop") at col 22. WINGS REWARD: a chain-hung cage perch (cols 6-11, top row 17), 7 tiles above the floor, GLAZED (X) bars, no wall within 6 tiles, with ch_geo3. One ladle_brute, one forge_wisp.

rooms.name: The Kiln Heart
contents: landmark:the heart of the forges - a round furnace chamber; the Kiln Mother's molten core glows behind her grate
rooms.notes: BOSS ARENA - THE KILN MOTHER, Warden of the Forge (64x18). Single entrance W1 (rows 12-14). Floor top row 15 (rows 15-17 solid) flat across cols 1-62: her molten floor waves and heated floor sections are attacks (telegraphed glow), so the tiles stay plain solid - no lava tiles. Ceiling solid rows 0-2; two one-way decks (=, top row 11) at cols 14-21 and 42-49 to escape floor waves. arena_gate (w1,h4) at col 2 rows 11-14 under a solid lintel at row 10. arena entity: boss kilnmother, bx=48, by=14 (her bulk fills the east third), trigger cols 10-30 rows 6-14. The east corner (cols 57-62) is solid wall behind her; the moldlings she spawns pour from ceiling vents over her back (cols 52-53, rows 1-2). Reward: Seal of the Kiln (+300 cinders).

rooms.name: The Reed Shallows
contents: landmark:the floodwater spills out of the tunnel into shallows among the first wick-reeds; pale moths rise from the water
rooms.notes: First Mothwood room (64x18), entered from the Flooded Tunnel at E1 (rows 12-14). Floor top row 15 (shallow puddles are decor only - no ~ on the walkway). W1 (rows 12-14) into the Wickreed Grove. S1 (cols 44-47) a hole down to the Silt Roots; around it the floor dips to top row 16 for 3 cols each side; the climb back up is inside mw_09. Wick-reeds (tall thin stalks with dead wicks for heads) frame the room. lore_mw_1 (a moth-keeper's ward-sign) at col 30. mw_geo3 among the reed roots at col 8. Two dusk_moths, a dust_maw lurking in a mound at col 22. Very dark: use moth-glow lights sparingly.

rooms.name: The Wickreed Grove
contents: landmark:THE WICKREED GROVE - wick-reeds as tall as towers sway in total stillness; their dead wicks form a canopy hung with giant silver cocoons
rooms.notes: REGION HUB and landmark (96x36). Forest floor top row 33 (rows 33-35 solid) with low roots (1-2 tile bumps): E1 (rows 30-32) from the Reed Shallows, W1 (rows 30-32) to the Cocoon Hollow, S1 (cols 20-23) a hole down to the Dustfall Hollow (floor dips to top row 34 for 3 cols each side; the climb back up is inside mw_08). mw_sconce_a at col 44 under a ring of glowing cocoons; Lanternway post mothwood at col 60; lore_mw_2 on a reed-stump at col 70. WINGS GATE to the canopy: the only way up is a ladder of reed-cap platforms (one-way =, 6 wide) each 6 tiles above the last - tops at rows 27, 21, 15, 9 - carried on a GLAZED (X) reed stem hanging from the canopy (cols 45-46, rows 2-28, clear of the floor path), with no walls or other footholds within 6 tiles (the room's side walls are far away), so only Smokewing climbs them; the last cap at top row 4 (cols 47-54) sits directly under N1 (cols 50-53), a 5-tile hop from row 9 (jump straight up through N1 to the Silk Galleries). Coming down is a free drop. Cocoon_spawners hang from the canopy (their spawn reaches the floor), dusk_moths drift, a dust_maw in the roots.

rooms.name: The Mothward Gate
contents: landmark:an old warded gate of moth-silk and iron; through its bars, far above, hangs the golden light of the gardens
rooms.notes: ONE-WAY SHORTCUT to Meltbloom (64x27). Floor top row 24. S1 (cols 40-43) is a hole down to the Cocoon Hollow (floor dips to top row 25 for 3 cols each side; the climb back up is inside mw_07). N1 (cols 20-23) leads up to the Root Hollows: mw_gate1 is a horizontal iron-and-silk grate (w4, h1, opens lever:mw_lv1) at row 2, cols 20-23, framed by solid tiles at cols 18-19 and 24-25 (rows 0-2). Under it one-way platforms with tops at rows 20, 16, 12 and 8, and a top ledge at row 5 (so the player fits under the frame and the closed grate) let the player climb right up to the grate; lever mw_lv1 stands on the top ledge at col 27 - struck from below, the grate swings open for good (from Meltbloom the player only ever saw the bars and a lever out of reach). mw_geo1 in a cocoon husk at col 52 on the floor. One moth_knight guards the floor, a dusk_moth flutters near the grate.

rooms.name: The Duchess's Bower
contents: landmark:a vaulted bower woven of silk and moonlight; a vast moth with eye-spotted wings rests on a throne of cocoons
rooms.notes: BOSS ARENA - DUCHESS VESPERTINE, Warden of the Wing (64x27). Single entrance W1 (rows 21-23). Floor top row 24 (rows 24-26 solid) flat across cols 1-62. She flies: keep rows 3-23 open over the whole width; ceiling solid rows 0-2 (silk vault). Three one-way silk platforms (=) give the player height to strike her: tops at row 18 (cols 10-17 and 46-53) and row 13 (cols 28-35). No tile hazards (dust clouds, gusts and moths are her attacks). arena_gate (w1,h4) at col 2 rows 20-23 under a solid lintel at row 19. arena entity: boss vespertine, bx=46, by=10 (she rests on the cocoon throne at the east end, airborne), trigger cols 10-30 rows 14-23. The player arrives with Smokewing (the room is only reachable through the canopy). Reward: Seal of the Wing (+300 cinders).

rooms.name: The Cocoon Deep
contents: landmark:a pit packed with sealed cocoons; one, larger than the rest, is fused to the floor and cracked open like a shell
rooms.notes: Room (64x27). N1 (cols 20-23) from the Cocoon Hollow: one-way platforms tops rows 12, 8, 4 under it, rising from the upper floor (top row 15, cols 1-40) at E1 (rows 12-14, to the Dustfall Hollow). The upper floor ends at col 38; the room steps down east in 3-tile steps (cols 39-41 top 18, cols 42-44 top 21) to a lower floor top row 24 (cols 45-62); E1 is reached by a silk shelf on the east wall (top 15, cols 54-62) over ledges at tops 21 and 18 at E2 (rows 21-23, to the Chrysalis Chapel). PLUNGE REWARD: on the upper floor the giant fused cocoon is a D floor (cols 8-13, rows 15-16) over a sealed chamber (cols 4-30, air rows 17-21, floor top row 22) holding Chandler's Spark spark_mw; climb out by two silk rungs (tops rows 20 and 18, cols 9-12) under the broken hole (chamber floor 22 -> rungs -> upper floor 15; no Smokewing needed). Cocoon_spawners on the walls, a moth_knight on the lower floor.

rooms.name: The Silk Galleries
contents: landmark:galleries of woven silk high in the canopy, hung with the Duchess's banners of eye-spotted wings
rooms.notes: Canopy room (64x27) above the Grove, reached only with Smokewing. S1 (cols 18-21) opens down into the Grove: around it the floor dips to top row 25 for 3 cols each side (landing ledge for players rising off the Grove's last reed-cap). Floor top row 24 of thick silk; the west side is a solid silk wall. E1 (rows 21-23) to the Duchess's Bower through a silk curtain arch. mw_sconce_b at col 40 (the rest before the Warden; moth-glow light). lore_mw_3 (the Duchess's oath to the Queen) woven into a banner at col 30. A moth_knight patrols; dusk_moths. Dropping back through S1 returns to the Grove floor.

rooms.name: The Cocoon Hollow
contents: landmark:a hollow trunk of one ancient reed, its inside lined with cocoons from top to bottom
rooms.notes: Vertical room (64x36) on the region's west edge. E1 (rows 30-32, floor top row 33) from the Grove. S1 (cols 20-23) a hole down to the Cocoon Deep (floor dips to top row 34 for 3 cols each side; the climb back up is in mw_05). N1 (cols 40-43) up to the Mothward Gate: a free climb of one-way platforms / silk ledges with tops at rows 29, 25, 21, 17, 13, 9, 5 (alternating sides of cols 36-47; the top one directly under N1). WINGS REWARD: a tall GLAZED cocoon perch (rows 12-17, top row 12) hangs from the ceiling by a glazed stalk (cols 6-7, rows 4-11), 7 tiles above the nearest reachable platform (top 19 or lower on the west side - keep the west platforms at or below row 19 and the perch GLAZED X, with no wall within 6 tiles), holding mw_geo2 (col 9). The west ledges are supported (row-25 ledge cols 3-10 touches the west wall). Moth_knight on the floor, cocoon_spawner on the wall, dust_maw in the roots.

contents: landmark:a hollow where moth-dust falls like grey snow and muffles every sound
rooms.notes: Corridor (96x18) under the Grove. Floor top row 15 (W1 and E1 rows 12-14). N1 (cols 20-23) up to the Grove: one-way platforms tops rows 12, 8, 4 under it. S1 (cols 60-63) a hole down to the Chrysalis Chapel; around it the floor dips to top row 16 for 3 cols each side (the climb back is inside mw_10). Moth-dust falls constantly (particles). SECRET: the ceiling hangs low between cols 34 and 50 (solid rows 0-8, air rows 9-14); its west face at cols 34-35 rows 6-8 is B, reached from a root ledge (cols 28-32, top row 9; 3-tile steps from the floor at tops 12 and 9): behind it an alcove (cols 36-44, rows 6-8, floor top 9) holds the Last Light sigil. Two dust_maws in the floor, two dusk_moths.

breakable wall (B) of silt behind Wren's camp

contents: landmark:roots of the great reeds plunge into frozen silt; a small traveler has made camp under them, her flame very low
rooms.notes: Vertical room (64x36). N1 (cols 44-47) from the Reed Shallows: one-way platforms tops rows 12, 8, 4 under it, reached from an upper floor (cols 30-62, floor top row 15) at W1 (rows 12-14, to the Dustfall Hollow). The room steps down west/south in 3-4 tile steps to a lower floor top row 33 at W2 (rows 30-32, to the Chrysalis Chapel). Wren (stage 3) camps on the lower floor at col 49 by a tiny fire. SECRET: behind her camp a cracked root wall (B, cols 55-56) hides a den (cols 57-62, east of the D floor) with Kiln Glass mw_kg (the west wall holds the W2 doorway). Root shelves at row 19 (cols 12-17) and row 23 (cols 20-28) touch the root masses. PLUNGE GATE (one-way into the Rime): a frozen cracked floor - D at cols 38-45, rows 33-34 - over the S1 opening (cols 40-43, row 35 open): the drop into the Long Cold; no way back up through it. Frost creeping up from the cracks shows the promise. One moth_knight on the upper floor, one dusk_moth.

rooms.name: The Chrysalis Chapel
contents: landmark:a chapel inside an enormous empty chrysalis; at its heart a blue ember floats among drifting grey wing-scales
rooms.notes: SMOKEWING SHRINE (96x18). Three ways in: N1 (cols 60-63) from the Dustfall Hollow, W1 (rows 3-5) from the Cocoon Deep onto a high west balcony (cols 1-14, floor top row 6), E1 (rows 12-14, floor top row 15) from the Silt Roots. Main floor top row 15. Under N1: one-way platforms tops rows 12, 8, 4 (climb back up). The west balcony steps down to the floor in 3-tile steps (tops 9, 12, 15) and can be climbed back the same way. Smokewing shrine at col 46 in the chrysalis' heart (big pale light). lore_mw_4 (a moth-priest's prayer for flight) at col 30. Two dusk_moths outside the inner shell (none near the shrine).

rooms.name: The Frozen Stair
contents: landmark:a stair of frozen wax spiralling down into blue cold; waxen pilgrims stand frozen on its steps
rooms.notes: Arrival room from the Sunken Crypt (64x36). N1 (cols 12-15) is where a plunging player falls in: the shaft below it (cols 10-17, rows 0-14) has GLAZED (X) ice walls and no ledges - there is no way back up (one-way). The fall lands on an ice shelf, floor top row 15, spanning cols 8-63 to E1 (rows 12-14, to the Causeway). From the shelf's west end a frozen stair of 3-tile steps descends (from a ledge against the west wall it winds back east under the shelf) to the lower floor (cols 1-30, floor top row 33) at W1 (rows 30-32, to the Long Cold); it is climbable both ways without abilities. CHUTE: a 4-wide hole in the shelf (cols 52-55) opens a chute (# ice walls, grippable, no ledges; rows 16-35) straight down to S1 (cols 52-55) and the Sanctum Gate room; its bottom is barred by ri_gate1 inside ri_08 until the lever ri_lv1 is struck from below - a one-way shortcut back up from Sable's second duel. Dropping into the chute before that only lands on the grate (wall-jump back up with grip). Frozen pilgrim statues (decor) on the steps. lore_ri_1 (a frozen pilgrim's last words) at col 30 on the shelf. Two frost_husks on the stair, a shard_crawler on the walls.

rooms.name: The Rime Causeway
contents: landmark:a long causeway over a frozen chasm, lined with waxen statues sealed in clear ice
rooms.notes: Long causeway room (128x27). Floor top row 15 (W1 and E1 rows 12-14): an ice causeway with low parapets over a frozen chasm (rows 16-26 below the causeway are open chasm in the middle part, cols 20-110; its floor top row 22 is ice with ^ ice shards on row 21 (kept in view from the causeway so the chasm reads as deadly) - a fall costs 1 health and the hazard respawn returns the player to the causeway; the chasm walls at cols 19 and 111 are GLAZED (X) on rows 17-21). Small gaps (<= 5 tiles) in the causeway for rhythm. FROZEN FALL (one-way drop, shortcut to the lake): near the east end the causeway has a 4-wide thin-ice one-way floor (cols 122-125; Down+Jump drops through, so nobody walking in from E1 falls by accident) over a chute that drops straight through S1 (cols 122-125) onto the Frozen Lake; no climbing back up it. lore_ri_2 (a pilgrims' marker frozen fast) at col 66. ri_geo1 frozen against the west face of the parapet at col 101. Ice_spitters on the parapets, frost_husks on the causeway, a shard_crawler under the ceiling.

rooms.name: The Long Cold
contents: landmark:a frozen tunnel where a whole procession of waxen pilgrims stands frozen mid-step, all walking down
rooms.notes: Long corridor (160x18) under the Mothwood. Floor top row 15 (E1 rows 12-14 to the Frozen Stair). N1 (cols 40-43): the one-way drop from the Silt Roots' cracked floor lands here on a snow drift; the shaft above has GLAZED (X) ice walls, no ledges. The frozen procession (decor) fills the tunnel. WINGS REWARD: at the west end (cols 6-14) an ice shelf at top row 8, 7 tiles above the floor, GLAZED (X) faces and no wall within 6 tiles, holds Heartwax Shard ri_hw1. ri_geo2 in the ice at col 80. Frost_husks, a rime_wraith drifting through walls, shard_crawlers.

rooms.name: The Icebound Stair
contents: landmark:a frozen crossroads; a narrow ice stair climbs into the dark toward the faint sound of rain - the way home
rooms.notes: Crossroads of the Rime (64x27); every Rime entry leads here freely. Floor top row 15 (W1 and E1 rows 12-14). ri_sconce_a at col 34 (the first rest in the Rime; light). THE WAY HOME: N1 (cols 20-23) is the foot of the Reliquary's ice stair - one-way platforms under it with tops at rows 11, 7 and 4 (the top one directly under N1); from there the player wall-jumps (grip) up the enclosed shaft in dn_12 and drops into the Nave. Frost-rimmed steps and a faint warm draught mark it clearly. S1 (cols 40-43): a hole in the floor down to the Frozen Lake, sunk in a well (cols 37-46) with dips at top row 25 beside the hole and one-way rungs at rows 21 and 17 (the floor is 11 rows above the room bottom, so the upward boost out of ri_04 lands in the well); the climb back up is inside ri_04. One ice_spitter on a ledge.

rooms.name: The Glacier Gallery

spots.secret: breakable wall (B) of packed snow at the east end

contents: landmark:a gallery cut through a glacier; the ice is so clear that drowned forges can be seen frozen inside it
rooms.notes: Corridor (128x18) under the Chandlery. Floor top row 15 (W1 rows 12-14 to the Icebound Stair). N1 (cols 78-81): the one-way drop from the Quench Gate's cracked floor lands here; the shaft above has GLAZED (X) ice walls and no ledges. Frozen forges and moldlings visible inside the ice (decor). SECRET: at the east end a B wall of packed snow (cols 112-113, rows 12-14) hides an ice cave (cols 114-126, rows 10-14, floor top 15) with the Deep Kindle sigil beside a frozen waxen who died kindling. Two rime_wraiths, two shard_crawlers.

rooms.name: The Frozen Lake
contents: landmark:THE FROZEN LAKE - a vast sheet of ice under a cavern sky of icicles; a lone small figure sits at its edge by a hole in the ice; beyond, a sheer wall of ice hides the way down
rooms.notes: Landmark (96x36). N2 (cols 72-75) from the Icebound Stair: one-way platforms tops rows 20, 16, 12, 8, 4 (the top one directly under N2) climb back up. N1 (cols 26-29) is the bottom of the Frozen Fall from the Causeway: players drop in onto the lake (one-way; nothing to climb back) down a hollow GLAZED column (X walls at cols 25 and 30, rows 0-17) so a dash cannot carry a falling player onto the wings-wall top. EAST SHORE: the frozen lake - a flat ice floor top row 24 across cols 23-95 (solid ice, no liquid). Wren (stage 4, nearly cold) sits at the lake edge at col 56 by a fishing hole (decor); Lanternway post rime at col 84; lore_ri_4 (Sable's note to her mother, scratched in black wax on the ice; she guards the next room) at col 66. WINGS GATE: at the lake's west end a sheer ice wall (cols 15-22, GLAZED X on every face) rises to top row 17 - exactly 7 tiles above the lake - with no ledges and no grippable surface within 6 tiles; only Smokewing reaches its top. West of it the ground falls away to the FAR SHORE (cols 1-14, floor top row 33) at W1 (rows 30-32, to Sable's second duel). Going back east needs Smokewing too: two GLAZED (X) ice pillars on the far shore - ledge A (cols 1-6, top row 27, the lintel over W1, attached to the west wall) and pillar B (cols 9-14, top row 21), each 6 rows above the last - lead back to the wall top (row 17, a 4-row hop from pillar B). ri_sconce_b on the far shore at col 8 at the foot of the pillars (the rest before Sable). Rime_wraiths over the lake, a frost_husk on the shore.

rooms.name: The Last Guard
contents: landmark:a frozen hall before the Sanctum stair; the black-wax duelist stands in falling snow, scarf frozen stiff
rooms.notes: BOSS ARENA - SABLE, Last Guard of the Heart (64x18). Floor top row 15 flat across cols 1-62 (rows 15-17 solid; plain ice, no spikes). Ceiling solid rows 0-1; keep rows 2-14 open across the width for her frost-smoke dives. Two one-way ice platforms (=, top row 10) at cols 12-18 and 45-51. W1 and E1 rows 12-14 with solid lintels at row 10 above each door. arena_gate (w1,h4) at col 61 rows 11-14 (east, behind the player); gate ri_gate9 (w1,h4, opens boss:sable2) at col 2 rows 11-14 (west, toward the Seal Door, shut until she yields) - both closed during the duel. arena entity: boss sable2, bx=12, by=14 (she waits before the west door), trigger cols 24-40 rows 6-14. After she yields, both gates open and she reappears at the Sanctum gate (npc sable stage 2 in ri_08).

rooms.name: The Sanctum Gate
contents: landmark:THE SEAL DOOR - a door of gold and black glass with three empty sockets (a bell, a kiln, a wing); light leaks around its edges
rooms.notes: The way down to the Sanctum (64x36). E1 (rows 21-23) from Sable's arena; floor top row 24 across cols 10-62. THE SEAL DOOR (sealdoor entity, about 3 wide x 6 tall) stands across the floor at cols 7-9, rows 18-23, in a solid gold-and-glass frame (cols 6-10 solid from row 0 to row 17 above it); it opens when the player holds all three Warden Seals (seals>=3). Behind it (cols 1-6) the floor at top row 24 has the S1 shaft (cols 2-5) going straight down (rows 24-35, # walls) into the Sanctum; dropping in is free, and the climb back needs no grip: three niches in the east wall (col 6: rows 30-32 over floor top 33, rows 26-28 over 29, row 24 over 25) are the footholds. ONE-WAY SHORTCUT: N1 (cols 20-23) leads up into the Frozen Stair's chute; ri_gate1 is a horizontal grate (w4, h1, opens lever:ri_lv1) at row 2, cols 20-23, framed by solid tiles at cols 18-19 and 24-25 (rows 0-2). Under it one-way platforms with tops at rows 20, 16, 12, 8 and 4 (the top one is split into cols 20-23 under the grate and cols 26-28, so the player fits under the frame); lever ri_lv1 stands on the top platform at col 27 - struck after the duel it opens the way straight back up to the Frozen Stair (grip climb in the chute). npc sable stage 2 (requires boss:sable2) stands aside near the door at col 30. lore_ri_3 (the three Wardens' oath, BELL. FORGE. WING.) carved beside the sockets at col 36. No enemies.

rooms.name: The Descent of Light
contents: landmark:a shaft of crystal through which golden light falls like slow rain
rooms.notes: Shaft (32x36) below the Seal Door. N1 (cols 2-5) at the top; the player falls through golden light shafts to the floor (top row 33).
